raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "see"
  role subject "Paul"
  role object "the incident from the weekend"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "see"
  role subject "nobody from the team"
  role object "the incident from the weekend"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "see"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the incident from the weekend"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Paul"
